benchmarkDenominator.runner: cargo test workspace and crate-level tests
benchmarkDenominator.runnerStatus: not executed; the upstream cache is sparse/no-checkout and a Cargo run would require materializing crate source plus building Rust workspace dependencies. Full cargo test would also hydrate/build beyond the current VM cap, so this run used targeted static inventory only.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is stronger than the seed manifest and now includes targeted object/ref plus focused loose-ref, packed-ref, reference-store overlay, pack-index, pack-data/delta, object-database, alternates, replacements, multi-pack-index, protocol v2, and fetch negotiation test counts, but it is still not upstream pass parity. Next slice should run a controlled crate-level cargo no-run/test probe after materializing only the needed crate paths or map fetch response/sideband semantics.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native loose Git object storage, canonical commit header parsing, Git tree entry parsing/serialization, loose direct/symbolic reference parsing and storage, packed-ref header/reference/peeled lookup parsing, protocol v2 capability, ls-refs parsing, fetch feature negotiation and argument building, loose+packed reference-store overlay resolution, v2 pack-index parsing/lookup, multi-pack-index parsing/lookup, MIDX-backed object database pack selection/de-duplication, pack data entry decoding, OFS_DELTA/REF_DELTA object resolution, and pack+loose+alternate object database lookup/prefix/iteration with replacement refs.

wordpressScenario: Git-backed WordPress content workflows, package installs, Playground snapshots, and server-side repo primitives; current examples parse a WordPress deploy tree, write/read HEAD plus deployment branch refs, inspect packed branch/tag refs, parse protocol v2 ls-refs discovery responses, build a shallow blobless ref-in-want fetch request, resolve loose+packed refs, locate compacted object offsets through pack indexes and multi-pack-indexes, use MIDX-backed object database pack selection/de-duplication, read delta-resolved packed commit/blob objects, and traverse a pack+loose+alternate object database with replacement refs without shelling out to git.
nextTask: Map protocol v2 fetch response sections and sideband pack handling, or run a controlled gix-protocol/gix-transport crate no-run probe if the VM remains clear.
